svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pan: cut 760 x 600 mm from 3 mm mild steel plate; grind the edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and round the corners to about 10 mm. Mark a 572 mm circle in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle with a centre line each way: the drum stands on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board: cut a 600 x 600 mm square from a 25 mm ceramic fibre board

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sheet (1260 deg C grade) with a fine saw; wear a dust mask.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a groove 4 wide x 4 deep in its underside, from 150 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind the centre, 50 mm left of it, straight out to the back edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block thermocouple: lay its tip on the back block in line with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: groove, 150 mm behind the centre; the lead runs out at the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: blocks, then board centred on them, then the pan on the board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pan rests flat without rocking; the lead is not pinched.
